SELECT statement_timestamp()::text AS observed_at,pid,state,backend_start::text AS backend_start,query_start::text AS query_start,state_change::text AS state_change,xact_start::text AS xact_start,wait_event_type,wait_event,
 CASE WHEN client_addr IS NULL THEN 'local_socket' WHEN client_addr << inet '127.0.0.0/8' OR client_addr=inet '::1' THEN 'loopback'
 WHEN client_addr << inet '10.0.0.0/8' OR client_addr << inet '172.16.0.0/12' OR client_addr << inet '192.168.0.0/16' THEN 'private_network' ELSE 'other_network' END AS client_address_class,
 CASE WHEN application_name ILIKE '%postgrest%' THEN 'postgrest' WHEN application_name='' THEN 'empty' ELSE 'other' END AS application_name_class,
 encode(extensions.digest(query,'sha256'),'hex') AS query_sha256,octet_length(query) AS query_bytes,
 query ~ '"?api"?[.]"?wave5_cash_date_command"?[[:space:]]*[(]' AND position('pg_stat_activity' in query)=0 AS actual_cash_api_call,
 query_start BETWEEN timestamptz '2026-10-13 12:32:35+00' AND timestamptz '2026-10-13 12:33:20.718+00' AS query_start_in_original_intent_timeout_window,
 backend_start BETWEEN timestamptz '2026-10-13 12:32:24+00' AND timestamptz '2026-10-13 12:33:20.718+00' AS backend_start_in_original_phase_window
 FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid=66780 AND usename='authenticator' AND state='active' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()
 AND query ~ '"?api"?[.]"?wave5_cash_date_command"?[[:space:]]*[(]' AND position('pg_stat_activity' in query)=0
